subGoals: Private Blob access without public exposure
insightsApplied: scale-storage: existing account referenced, not recreated
scale-app: B2 supports same-region outbound integration

reasoning.whyChosen: Same-region private access and subnet separation
reasoning.tradeoffs: No peering, NAT or firewall needed for this narrow approved scope

reasoning.whyChosen: Resolve normal Blob hostname to private IP
Private endpoint DNS available inside integration VNet
Private connection to existing public-disabled storage
alternativesConsidered: Storage service endpoint with public access: rejected

overallReasoning.summary: Additive storage-only network deployment; separately integrate existing app via approved CLI operation. Existing PostgreSQL, identity, storage configuration and app ingress retained.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Single-region baseline, no new DR/firewall/NAT; private endpoint NIC billed, existing compute separate. App integration/release can restart the worker. Fresh customer resources require separate approval.

plan.validation: CIDRs nonoverlapping in current subscription inventory; app B2 and VNet same region; delegated app subnet separate from Blob endpoint subnet; public storage remains Disabled; original whole-stack template unchanged.
